english.meaning: the real person, face to face rather than on screen
english.note: As in 未見過佢真人, never seen them in person.

exampleSentences.english: Of course not. I hardly ever see them. I don’t think I’ve ever even seen them in person.
exampleSentences.traditional: 梗係唔係喇。嘩我幾可見到佢。我諗我都未見過佢，未見過佢真人。
